```{r, setup}
library(tidyverse)
```

#Read in some data
-open data csv doesn't work, is not reproducible 

#absolute directions
-using go along path on your own computer, not reproducible 
#realitve path
-backwards one step
-starting point getting directions from this path 
-benefit of doing R projects and construct relative paths for Rproject, R project is our starting point
-reproducible

Read in the litters dataset. Study on fecal alcohol syndrome using mice. 
```{r}
litters_df = read_csv("./data/FAS_litters.csv")
litters_df = janitor::clean_names(litters_df)
```
No need to load whole janitor package so just load one function from it 
Don't use dollar signs when creating a folder 


#Take a look at the data

```{r}

```

First 6 rows 

```{r}

```

```{r}
skimr::skim(litters_df)
```
Some summary data

#Options to read_csv
```{r}
litters_df=read_csv("./data/FAS_litters.csv", skip=10, col_names=FALSE)
```
Useful if first row is blank or a description of the data set

```{r}
litters_df=read_csv("./data/FAS_litters.csv", na=c("", "NA",".", 999))
```
This makes all missing values being seen as na instead of combination of something



#Other File Formats

Read in an Excel File

```{r}
library(readxl)
mlb_df = read_excel("./data/mlb11.xlsx")
mlb_df
```
Can restrict range that cells are read
```{r}
mlb_df = read_excel("./data/mlb11.xlsx", range = "A1:F7")
mlb_df
```

Read in a SAS File 

```{r}
library(haven)
pulse_df = read_sas("./data/public_pulse_data.sas7bdat")
pulse_df
```

Export the mlb sub_table
